children: on Tuesday it had launched a public offering of an additional
8% notes due in 2031, which trade on the NYSE under the ticker SAX.
The new notes will have the same terms and rank equally with the $97.75M aggregate principal amount of 8% notes due in 2031 previously issued in August and September.
The company plans to use the proceeds to repay Valley National Bank debt or redeem its 8% notes due in 2027.
Lucid Capital Markets and Oppenheimer are serving as joint book-running managers.
